{{Dablink|This article's plot summary may be found on the article about the original work, [[{{{1}}}#Plot summary|{{{2|''{{{1}}}''}}}]].}}<noinclude>{{Top|sprot}}

==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>Plot-link|{{Var|original article}}|{{Var|display text}}}}</code>

In accordance with [[Wookieepedia:Layout Guide/Out-of-universe#Published narrative works]], the Plot summary section of an article about an unabridged audiobook or scriptbook should use this template directing to the original work's article.

===Required parameters===
#{{Para||{{Var|original article}}}} The title of the original work's article.

===Optional parameters===
#<li value="2">{{Para||{{Var|display text}}}} The formatted title of the original work's article, if needed. The display text is italicized by default.</li>

==Examples==
===Code===
<pre><nowiki>{{Plot-link|Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'' (novel)}}</nowiki></pre>

===Result===
{{Plot-link|Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'' (novel)}}

[[Category:Internal link templates]]
</noinclude>
